title: Cosmic Mosaic Muse
description: A surreal portrait of a woman with dark skin whose face, neck, and shoulders are composed of colorful geometric mosaic tiles and digital fragments. Her hair is an explosion of vibrant flowers, social media icons including TikTok logos, hearts, and floating geometric shapes set against a cosmic background of nebulae, stars, and a glowing comet.
prompt: Surreal portrait of a beautiful Black woman whose face and body are fragmented into a vibrant mosaic of colorful geometric tiles and digital patterns. Her hair explodes into a crown of pink cosmos flowers, TikTok logos, hearts, and floating shapes. She emerges from a pond of lily pads with lotus flowers, set against a dramatic cosmic nebula and comet sky in rich psychedelic colors, intricate details, vibrant fantasy style.
